name: Emoji Quiz Party
shortDescription: A presenter-driven emoji guessing game for Zoom calls. Players guess movies, songs, and phrases from emoji combos while a 60-second timer reveals progressive clues.

suggestion.prompt: Build a mobile-first Emoji Quiz game suitable for Zoom call. Setup screen: Presenter enters player names (add/remove). Start game when ready. Game screen: - 5 round game begins. - Display current round's Type (Movie / Song / Phrase) in a label - Show large, prominent emojis as the main challenge - Run and display a 60-second countdown timer that reveals 3 clues progressively: Hard clue at ~40s, Medium at ~20s, Easy at ~5s remaining - Show all player name buttons so the presenter can tap to award a point — allow ties (multiple players can be selected per round) - Track and display scores for all players throughout - Show Next Round button to advance - Show a persistent End Game button End Game screen: - Display a styled final scoreboard ranked by score with winner highlighted Data: Preload at least 20 rounds of emoji sets. Data should be stored as emojis,type,title,clue_hard,clue_medium,clue_easy Use a vibrant, fun visual design suited for a group game viewed on screen share.

improvements.description: Added host answer display options: separate popup window, browser notification, and developer console, selectable from the setup screen.
Improved host browser notifications reliability and fixed tie-aware medal placement in final scores.
Persisted setup player names in local browser storage and added a remove-all users action on setup.

generation.notes: Built from community suggestion #259. Emoji quiz party game with setup/game/scoreboard screens, 20 preloaded quiz rounds, progressive clue timer, and confetti celebration. Token counts are estimates.
